system.description:
Puncture-resistant cloth or thick material such as leather worn as a vest or jacket.

Difficulty to hit: 9+. Carry weight 2kg, worn weight 1kg.

Jack armour material lined with a metal mesh weave.

Difficulty to hit: 10+. Carry weight 3kg, worn weight 1.5kg.

Padded ballistic-resistant jacket.

Difficulty to hit: 11+. Carry weight 6kg, worn weight 3kg.

Synthetic, metal, and advanced ceramic plates worn over clothing.

Difficulty to hit: 12+. Carry weight 30kg, worn weight 15kg.

Disposable jack armour designed to absorb damage but be destroyed in the process.

Difficulty to hit: 9+. Carry weight 2kg, worn weight 1kg.

  • Absorbing: This armour negates the first attack that hits that deals between 2D-6D of damage, but is destroyed in the process. Once the armor is destroyed, the wearer is considered unarmoured (8+ to hit). This armour is considered disposable and cannot be repaired.

Designed for combatting energy weapons by deflecting energy beams off of the wearer.

Difficulty to hit: 9+. Carry weight 1kg, worn weight 500g.

  • Reflective: Reflects energy weapons away from the wearer but is downgraded to Jack armour after deflecting 2D-6D damage. This armour can be repaired to be reflective again for 250cr.

An external armour frame that functions as a vaccsuit as well as doubling the strength of the wearer and negating END limit to melee attacks.

Difficulty to hit: 14+. Carry weight 50kg, worn weight 5kg.

  • Vaccsuit: This armour functions as a vaccsuit as well as protection in combat. Battledress functions as a vaccsuit of TL 14.
